notes: Simulation models (gbm, reservoir) use drivers only (weather, soil wetness, MODIS cover, CDL, observed streamflow) - no lagged nitrate. Persistence baselines use nitrate observed 7/14 days earlier, so they are forecasts with information the simulation models do not get.
Metrics are computed on concentration (mg/L) over days with an observation and a prediction.
gbm p10/p90 are conformalized (CQR) with leave-one-year-out residuals from 2016-2022.
Cover features are causal (as-of MODIS composites; see notes/model.md).

v2.description: v2 (legacy-N): v1 monotone quantile GBM + causal N-carryover store features (S_t = S_{t-1} exp(-D_t/k) + corn-share spring input, D = rain x GWETROOT^2), Raccoon trained on 2012-2022 (nitrate from 2012-03-02), Des Moines on 2016-2022.
v2.caveat: v2 was designed AFTER seeing the v1 miss of the 2025 crisis, so its 2023-2025 test score is NOT a clean out-of-time test. See strict_check for a stricter evaluation.

blind_2013.pre_registered: 2013 chosen by the verifier BEFORE v2 was fitted, as the analog of 2025 (record flush after the 2012 drought). v2 hyperparameters and k selected by LOYO CV without 2013.

display_model.rule: Use v2 for a site iff (a) v2 leave-one-year-out CV ln-RMSE averaged over the 2016-2022 folds <= v1's (v1 value from models/config_<site>.json) AND (b) in the strict check (train 2012-2019 Raccoon / 2016-2019 Des Moines, test 2020-2025) v2's pooled ln-RMSE < that of the v1 feature set trained on the same years with v1's hyperparameters. Rule fixed before any 2026 metric was computed; 2026 not used.
